title: Needs to talk to her husband first
scenario: Mia is looking at a move-up purchase but says her husband handles the finances and she needs to talk to him. The rep tries to get both on one call with a two-option close.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Mia? This is Carlos with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yes, hi, sorry, the kids are being loud, give me one sec.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: No rush at all.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. Sorry. Hi.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, no worries. How many kids do you have?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Three, and a fourth on the way, which is exactly why we need a bigger house.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Congratulations! That'll do it. So are you thinking of selling your current place and buying?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the plan. We've been looking at four bedrooms out by the new elementary school.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great area. Do you have a sense of what you'd want your budget to be?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Honestly my husband does all the money stuff. I really need to talk to him before I say anything.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That makes total sense, it's a big decision and you should both be in it. Rather than you having to relay everything, would it be easier if I hopped on a quick call with both of you?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Maybe. He works pretty long days though.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Understood. Would this evening around seven or Saturday morning around ten work better for both of you?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Saturday morning would probably be better. He's wiped out on weeknights.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Saturday at ten it is. It'll be about twenty minutes. It'd help if he has your current mortgage statement handy.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. Do we have to sell our house before we can buy the new one?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Not necessarily, there are a few ways to handle that, and it depends on your equity and income. That's a great one to dig into Saturday with both of you.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay, good, because that's the thing that stresses me out.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally understandable. I'll send a calendar invite to you, and if you give me his email I'll include him too.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll text it to you.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. Thanks Mia, good luck with the chaos.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Ha, thanks. Bye.
